rationale: Builds directly on the current best staged reverse-tail recurrence curriculum, but adds a tiny learned anchor-refresh path inside the recurrent tail. Local history says anchor-refresh variants and recurrent-tail structural edits are still live, while scalar-only sweeps have plateaued. This keeps shapes and runtime stable, adds very few bytes, and specifically targets a likely weak point in the current best script: a fixed decoder-output anchor that may be too rigid once later recurrent passes start improving the tail state.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Gate
